title: Coil
summary: COIL, verb transitive To gather, as a line or cord into a circular form; to wind into a ring, as a serpent, or a rope. COIL, noun 1. A rope gathered into a ring; on shipboard, a single turn or winding

inlines.v: COIL, verb transitive To gather, as a line or cord into a circular form; to wind into a ring, as a serpent, or a rope. COIL, noun 1. A rope gathered into a ring; on shipboard, a single turn or winding is called a fake, and a range of fakes is called a tier. 2. A noise, tumult, bustle.
